description: This file defines a sourceURL type and functions to fetch and parse Pod configurations from a URL, used within the Kubernetes kubelet component for dynamic pod configuration updates.

classes.name: sourceURL
classes.description: A struct representing a URL source for pod configurations, including URL, headers, node name, data, and HTTP client.

methods.name: NewSourceURL
methods.description: Creates a new sourceURL instance and starts watching the specified URL for pod configuration updates.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Periodically attempts to extract pod data from the URL and logs success or failure.

methods.name: applyDefaults
methods.description: Applies default settings to a pod based on the URL source.

methods.name: extractFromURL
methods.description: Fetches data from the URL, parses it as a pod or pod list, and sends updates accordingly.
